1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __500__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein said multivalent cation is selected from the group consisting of zirconium, aluminum, iron, titanium, and chromium.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine of less than __500__ Da.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein said cations are present in a concentration of less than 1% by weight relative to the total composition.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to __800__ nm in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine, and seawater at temperatures below __60__°C.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyalkylenimine has a molecular weight of less than __500__ Da.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle __incorporating__ a multivalent cation.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __one or more selected from the group consisting of__ Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe, or Al.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with said composition; and c) a fluid __selected from the group consisting of water, brine, and seawater__.

23) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, wherein the degree of hydrolysis is between __5% to 40%__. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide __with an average molecular weight between 1000 Da and 5000 Da__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where __the fluid is selected from the group consisting of fresh water, brine, and seawater, with a salinity of up to 35 g/L__.
